name: Kyoji Horiguchi
event: UFC Fight Night: Procházka vs. Stirling
summary: Japanese flyweight veteran (36-6, 1 NC, age 36) and former Bellator and Rizin champion, 2-1 since his UFC return. Fast, explosive karate-based striker. Lost his last fight to Manel Kape by R3 TKO in June after leading for most of it. UFC.com lists the pair at No. 5 and No. 7; Heavy.com has Horiguchi No. 5 in the media rankings.

how_they_fight.Striking: Very fast in-and-out blitzer with stance switches, an overhand right and a sharp left, and leg and body kicks. Out-landed Amir Albazi 73-16 with jumping knees in R3 (Cageside Press). 15 KO/TKO wins.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Takes down opponents late in rounds and grinds from top: put Kape on his back in R1 and R2 and landed elbows (Cageside). Six submission wins, most recently Tagir Ulanbekov (R3, 2025).
how_they_fight.Defense: Hard to hit (about 67% striking defense) and tough to take down (76%): stopped all seven Albazi takedown attempts. But he has been knocked out three times since 2019: Kai Asakura R1 (2019), Sergio Pettis R4 (2021) and Kape R3 (2026), where a right hand hurt him and an uppercut finished him (Cageside).
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Keeps a high pace for 15 minutes. Of 21 stoppage wins, 10 came in R1, 4 KOs and 3 subs in R2, 3 subs in R3 and one R5 KO. Fifteen wins were decisions. Five-round record is mixed: 2-4 counting the Kape fight. His three recent KO losses came in R1, R3 and R4, so the danger stays live late.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Experienced at the top level. Fights in bursts and resets well. Against Kape he was clearly winning and got caught in an exchange.

patterns: Recent KO losses to counter-punchers when trading
keys_to_beat: Chain wrestle; he defends single attempts well

news.text: Booked against Asu Almabayev in a three-round flyweight fight at UFC Qatar.
Lost to Manel Kape by TKO at 2:42 of R3 after controlling R1-R2.
